prompts: Use case: productivity-visual. Create ONE complete pitch-deck opening slide image, landscape 16:9, crisp high-resolution flat slide artwork, edge-to-edge, not a photographed screen. Design concept 1: elegant editorial split composition. Pure white background, 60% left text, 40% right three vertically stacked conversation/evidence cards, spacious margin, ink black typography, muted terracotta-orange accents, very thin pale gray dividers. The large wordmark "Sachet" in refined bold serif at upper-left. Beneath it large clean sans-serif tagline exactly "Spot the pattern. Pause before you pay." split onto two lines. Supporting text exactly "Financial scam workflow detection with clear evidence and timely alerts." Small footer exactly "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2" and below "Team ANKOR". On right, three clearly readable cards linked with delicate downward arrows: first text exactly "Your withdrawal is ready."; second text exactly "Pay a processing fee first."; third orange-tinted Sachet warning card with small heading "Sachet" and text exactly "An additional payment is being requested before access to the claimed funds. Verify independently before proceeding." Make a beautiful professional minimal cover slide with strong hierarchy, excellent spelling, generous whitespace. No member names, no scenario label, no extra text, no photos, no watermark, no gradient, no large shield illustration.
